_readme: What each recommended change takes, for sorting a corner's recommendations. quick: signal timing, signs or paint (no construction or new equipment). build: construction or new equipment (concrete, new signal hardware, lights, beacons). other: studies, enforcement, or work tied to a development. When unsure, an item goes in build, so the site never calls something easy that may not be. pipeline/plans.py stops if a plan has an item that isn't listed here. Bikeways are keyed by the plan's wording of the facility.
